text: Sheep milk is set with rennet and the curd is drained and left to mature, which gives lump cheese (hrudkový syr), the raw material of bryndza.

processing.text: Sheep milk (or mixed with cow milk) is set with rennet at 29–31 °C for 30 min; the curd is drained and matured in a cheese bath.
